description: A pair of promotional hero tiles, each with a title, tagline, two actions, and a product image.
overview: Two promotional tiles, each with a title, tagline, Learn more and Buy buttons and a product image, one of them rendered in the dark palette. The tiles stack on mobile and sit side by side on desktop. It is a static server component for promoting two products or offers on a home page.
usage: Edit the `tiles` array; each tile has a title, text, image, alt text and a `dark` flag. Dark tiles prefix their title with suiss, so remove that span if it doesn't fit your brand. Connect the buttons to your product pages.
